rows.en: Huh, Yuuto... What's up?
...I was waiting for you.
...Isn't there something you should be telling me?
Sigh... I guess it can't be helped...

I heard the rumors...
You've been hanging out with that girl a lot, huh...
rows.notes: ano onna = 'that woman': rendered 'that girl' (school setting); slightly milder than the Japanese.

rows.en:
I thought you were a better friend than that...
Well, remember me once in a while, okay!
Huh, Kagura-kun... What's wrong?
...Isn't there something you ought to tell me?

I heard the rumors...
You've been hanging out with that girl a lot, huh...

Honestly, it came as a shock...
Well, pay some attention to me once in a while too, okay!

I heard the rumors...
You've been hanging out with that guy a lot, huh...

I heard the rumors...
You've been hanging out with that guy a lot, huh...
(Well, guess I'll give it my all today, too.)
Hey, \p.
Good morning!
You seem lively this early.
Aren't you, Klan-senpai?

I went to bed late, so I'm sleepy...
*yaaawn*
I bet you were up late watching anime on TV, weren't you?

Th-That's not true!
I was just glued to a shopping channel!!
That's no different, honestly...

It's completely different! With a shopping
channel, the goods arrive after you watch!
And you actually bought something...
A-Anyway, let's go.
Hey, don't pull me!
Huh? Klan-senpai, where are you going?
Hm? To the third-year classroom, obviously.
Because I'm a third-year!
Who is?
I am!
Oh, right, now that you mention it...
You call me "Senpai" and look up to me, don't you!
(She's so tiny, I thought she was a year below me...)
...Honestly, what a rude one you are.
Ahahaha...

Whatever. I'm going on ahead!
The third-year classroom is a long way off!!
Ah! Senpai, no running in the hall...

Hey, Klan Klang!
No running in the halls!!
S-Sorry!
No matter how many times I tell you, you never learn!
Go on, get moving!
Grrr...
Wh-What are you looking at...
I-I didn't see anything! I didn't hear anything!
Hmph!!
(W-Well, guess I'll do my best too.)
That's no different, geez...
And you actually bought something...
Oh, right, now that you mention it...
(W-Well, guess I'll do my best too.)
(Ugh, I got stuck with math homework...)

(I wanted to do it before I forgot, but...
hmm, factoring, derivatives, integrals...)
Oh, Klan-senpai.
What are you doing in a place like this?
I got stuck with math homework...

I see.
Can't you just do it at home?
W-Well, yes, but I wanted to get it done before I forgot.
And yet you seemed to be groaning "hnnn, hnnn" over it?
Ahaha... It's so hard I can't make heads or tails of it...
Ah! I know!
I'm going home. Good luck.
Wai-! Klan-senpai!
What is it?
Senpai, please teach me!
Teach you what?
My homework.
Wh-Why?
Klan-senpai, you learned this last year, didn't you?
...I did, but...
Then you understand it, right?
O-Of course I do!

Please teach me!
It's the favor of a lifetime!!
You're the only one I can count on, Klan-senpai!!

Th-The only one you can count on is me...
*so touched*...
Please!!!

V-Very well.
A problem like this is a piece of cake for me!
I knew I could count on you!!
I just remembered something I have to do!
S-Senpai!!
(Don't tell me she couldn't do it either?)
